resources.name: Users
resources.description:
### Retrieve Users

This endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to retrieve a list of users.

#### Request Body

This request does not require a request body.

#### Response

- Status: 200
    
- Content-Type: application/json
    

##### Response Body

The response will include an array of user objects, each containing the following fields:

- `created_at` (string): The date and time when the user was created
    
- `email` (string): The user's email address
    
- `first_name` (string): The user's first name
    
- `id` (number): The unique identifier for the user
    
- `last_name` (string): The user's last name
    
- `updated_at` (string): The date and time when the user was last updated
    
- `username` (string): The user's username

resources.name: Profile

### Retrieve User Accounts

This endpoint is used to retrieve a list of user accounts.

#### Request

- Method: GET
    
- URL: `{{Prefix}}/api/accounts`
    

#### Response

The response will be a JSON array containing objects with the following properties:

- `account_number` (string, optional): The account number associated with the user.
    
- `account_type` (string, optional): The type of the account.
    
- `balance` (number): The current balance in the account.
    
- `created_at` (string, optional): The date and time when the account was created.
    
- `id` (number): The unique identifier for the account.
    
- `is_main` (boolean): Indicates if the account is the main account for the user.
    
- `updated_at` (string, optional): The date and time when the account was last updated.
    
- `user_id` (number): The unique identifier of the user to whom the account belongs.
    

``` json
[
  {
    "account_number": "",
    "account_type": "",
    "balance": 0,
    "created_at": "",
    "id": 0,
    "is_main": true,
    "updated_at": "",
    "user_id": 0
  }
]

 ```

resources.name: Budget
resources.description:
### Create a New Budget

This endpoint allows you to create a new budget.

#### Request Body

- `name`: (string) The name of the budget.
    
- `amount`: (number) The amount allocated for the budget.
    
- `category_id`: (number) The ID of the category for the budget.
    
- `duration_minutes`: (number) The duration of the budget in minutes.
    

#### Response

Upon successful creation, the endpoint returns the details of the newly created budget including:

- `id`: (number) The ID of the created budget.
    
- `name`: (string) The name of the budget.
    
- `amount`: (number) The amount allocated for the budget.
    
- `category`: (string) The category of the budget.
    
- `start_date`: (string) The start date of the budget.
    
- `end_date`: (string) The end date of the budget.
    
- `remaining_amount`: (number) The remaining amount of the budget.
    

### Example

```
POST {{Prefix}}/api/budgets
{
  "name": "Foya foya",
  "amount": 10000,
  "category_id": 2,
  "duration_minutes": 5
}

 ```

#### Response

- Status: 201
    
- {"id": 1,"name": "Foya foya","amount": 10000,"category": "example_category","start_date": "2023-01-01","end_date": "2023-12-31","remaining_amount": 10000}

- `remaining_amount`: The updated remaining amount of the budget.
    
- `start_date`: The updated start date of the budget.

resources.name: Transfer
resources.description:
### Create Transaction

This endpoint allows you to create a new transaction.

#### Request Body

- `account_id` (integer) - The ID of the account initiating the transaction.
    
- `to_account_number` (string) - The account number of the recipient.
    
- `amount` (number) - The amount of the transaction.
    
- `transaction_type` (string) - The type of transaction.
    
- `description` (string) - A description for the transaction.
    

#### Response

- `amount` (number) - The amount of the transaction.
    
- `category` (string) - The category of the transaction.
    
- `created_at` (string) - The timestamp of the transaction creation.
    
- `description` (string) - The description of the transaction.
    
- `from_account` (string) - The account from which the transaction originated.
    
- `from_account_id` (integer) - The ID of the account from which the transaction originated.
    
- `id` (integer) - The ID of the transaction.
    
- `to_account` (string) - The account to which the transaction is made.
    
- `to_account_id` (integer) - The ID of the account to which the transaction is made.
    
- `transaction_type` (string) - The type of transaction.
    

#### Example

``` json
{
  "account_id": 3,
  "to_account_number": "5782468643993712",
  "amount": 2999.55,
  "transaction_type": "transfer",
  "description": "Transfer test again"
}

 ```

``` json
{
  "amount": 0,
  "category": null,
  "created_at": "",
  "description": "",
  "from_account": "",
  "from_account_id": 0,
  "id": 0,
  "to_account": "",
  "to_account_id": 0,
  "transaction_type": ""
}

 ```

``` json
[
    {
        "description": "",

        "name": ""
    }
]

 ```

resources.name: Payment
resources.description:
### POST /api/transactions

This endpoint is used to create a new transaction.

#### Request Body

- `account_id` (number) - The ID of the account involved in the transaction.
    
- `amount` (number) - The amount of the transaction.
    
- `transaction_type` (string) - The type of transaction (e.g., payment, transfer).
    
- `description` (string) - A brief description of the transaction.
    
- `category_id` (number) - The ID of the category associated with the transaction.
    

#### Response (201 - Created)

The response will be in JSON format and will contain the following fields:

- `amount` (number) - The amount of the transaction.
    
- `category` (string) - The category associated with the transaction.
    
- `created_at` (string) - The timestamp of when the transaction was created.
    
- `description` (string) - A brief description of the transaction.
    
- `from_account` (string) - The account from which the transaction originated.
    
- `from_account_id` (number) - The ID of the account from which the transaction originated.
    
- `id` (number) - The ID of the transaction.
    
- `to_account` (string) - The account to which the transaction is directed.
    
- `to_account_id` (number) - The ID of the account to which the transaction is directed.
    
- `transaction_type` (string) - The type of transaction (e.g., payment, transfer).
    

#### JSON Schema for Response

``` json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "amount": { "type": "number" },
    "category": { "type": "string" },
    "created_at": { "type": "string" },
    "description": { "type": "string" },
    "from_account": { "type": "string" },
    "from_account_id": { "type": "number" },
    "id": { "type": "number" },
    "to_account": { "type": ["string", "null"] },
    "to_account_id": { "type": ["number", "null"] },
    "transaction_type": { "type": "string" }
  }
}

 ```
